infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Adaptivity uses the camera to capture brake pad, tire tread, and engine photos for Digital Vehicle Inspection (DVI) reports.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Adaptivity uses location to calculate mobile dispatch distance and display live van tracking.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Adaptivity uses continuous location to track mobile van dispatch progress while en route.
